name: e-invoicing-tr-withholding-codes
title: UBL-TR VAT withholding codes (e-Fatura)
description: The VAT withholding (KDV tevkifatı) codes written to TaxTypeCode under WithholdingTaxTotal in Turkish e-invoices, with their official Turkish descriptions and withholding rates: 27 partial withholding codes (6xx) and 25 full withholding codes (8xx).

sources.title: UBL-TR Kod Listeleri, Versiyon 1.43, Temmuz 2026 (section 1.9, Tevkifat Kodları Listesi), in UBLTR_1.2.1_Kilavuzlar.zip, Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-09

e-Fatura Paketi, schematron/UBL-TR_Codelist.xml (WithholdingTaxType, WithholdingTaxTypeWithPercent; package history up to 2026-07-01), Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı, retrieved 2026-11-05: used for schematron_percents

fields.name: code
fields.description: Three-digit withholding code written to cac:TaxScheme/cbc:TaxTypeCode under cac:WithholdingTaxTotal.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Description in Turkish as printed in the code list, including the KDV Genel Uygulama Tebliği section reference where the guide gives one. Line breaks of the PDF are joined; spelling is unchanged.

fields.name: type
fields.description: partial for the 6xx codes (kısmi tevkifat); full for the 8xx codes (tam tevkifat, 10/10).

fields.name: rate
fields.description: Withholding rate as printed in the guide, as a fraction of the VAT: 4/10 means four tenths of the calculated VAT is withheld by the buyer.

fields.name: rate_percent
fields.description: The same rate as a percentage of the VAT, the value written to cbc:Percent of the withholding subtotal (4/10 = 40).

fields.name: schematron_percents
fields.description: Percentages the UBL-TR schematron accepts for the code, separated by semicolons. For seven codes it also accepts an older rate besides rate_percent.
